customer: So I just moved out here to Eastvale a couple weeks ago and I'm still unpacking boxes, but I've got this full-size SUV that's honestly way too big for the streets around here and I'm thinking about selling it. I'm not really looking to get another car from you right now, maybe later, I don't know yet. How does selling it to you actually work, like what do I need to do first?
agent: Welcome to the area! As our article "Selling your car to Northwind: how it works" explains, there are four steps: first get an offer, either online with your VIN or license plate or by walking into any store for an on-the-spot quote, then book an appraisal appointment. A specialist will inspect your SUV in about 30 minutes and confirm the offer, and then you sign the paperwork and get paid. You don't have to buy a car from us to sell one, but keep in mind that offers last a limited time.
